description: This file defines a native MSSQL driver for the ADOdb Database Abstraction Layer library in PHP. It includes a class `ADODB_mssql` for database connection and query operations specific to MSSQL, along with related recordset classes.

classes.name: ADODB_mssql
classes.description: Main class implementing MSSQL database driver with methods for connection, querying, transaction control, and schema metadata.

classes.name: ADORecordset_mssql
classes.description: Class representing a recordset specifically for MSSQL, handling fetching and navigation of query results.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_array_mssql
classes.description: Array-based recordset implementation for MSSQL, extending base 'ADORecordSet_array'.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves MSSQL server information such as description and version.

methods.name: IfNull
methods.description: Returns SQL expression to handle NULL values using ISNULL syntax.

methods.name: _insertID
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted identity value using SCOPE_IDENTITY().

methods.name: qStr
methods.description: Properly quotes a string for MSSQL queries to prevent injection.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns number of rows affected by last operation.

methods.name: CreateSequence
methods.description: Creates a sequence table and initializes it for generating unique IDs.

methods.name: GenID
methods.description: Generates and returns a new sequence ID, incrementing the sequence table.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Executes a SQL query with limit and offset support.

methods.name: SQLDate
methods.description: Formats a date column into a string based on specified format.

methods.name: BeginTrans
methods.description: Begins a database transaction.

methods.name: CommitTrans
methods.description: Commits a transaction.

methods.name: RollbackTrans
methods.description: Rolls back a transaction.

methods.name: SetTransactionMode
methods.description: Sets transaction isolation level.

methods.name: RowLock
methods.description: Applies row locking to specified tables based on condition.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about table columns.

methods.name: MetaIndexes
methods.description: Retrieves index metadata for a table.

methods.name: metaForeignKeys
methods.description: Fetches foreign key constraints on a specified table.

methods.name: MetaDatabases
methods.description: Returns list of available databases.

methods.name: MetaPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Retrieves primary key columns for a table.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Lists tables in the database, filtered by type or name mask.

methods.name: SelectDB
methods.description: Switches to the specified database.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Retrieves the latest error message from MSSQL.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Retrieves the last error code from MSSQL.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a new MSSQL connection.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Establishes a persistent MSSQL connection.

methods.name: _nconnect
methods.description: Connects to MSSQL with nested connection support.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Prepares a SQL statement with placeholders.

methods.name: PrepareSP
methods.description: Prepares a stored procedure call.

methods.name: Concat
methods.description: Concatenates multiple strings or expressions for MSSQL.

methods.name: Parameter
methods.description: Binds a parameter to a prepared statement.

methods.name: UpdateBlob
methods.description: Updates BLOB or CLOB data in a table.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query or prepared statement.

methods.name: _close
methods.description: Closes the database connection.

methods.name: substr
methods.description: Returns a substring SQL expression for MSSQL.
